title: Hardware Radar synthetic collector input (hw-radar-input/v1)
description: Apify-dialect view of contract/hw-radar-input-v1.schema.json. The contract file is authoritative; hw-radar's tests pin this file to it.

siteKey.title: siteKey
siteKey.description: hw-radar SourceSite key the run collects for.

collectionScope.title: collectionScope
collectionScope.description: Scope key <site_key>:<category>:<query_id> the run was admitted for; echoed in OUTPUT.

categoryHint.title: categoryHint
categoryHint.description: hw-radar category slug stamped on every row.

maxItems.title: maxItems
maxItems.description: Hard cap on dataset rows. The Actor enforces it itself.

maxRequests.title: maxRequests
maxRequests.description: Hard cap on HTTP requests sent.

maxBytes.title: maxBytes
maxBytes.description: Hard cap on response-body bytes received across the run.

timeBudgetSecs.title: timeBudgetSecs
timeBudgetSecs.description: The Actor's own time budget; each request's timeout is the remaining budget. hw-radar always also sends an explicit run timeout.

schemaVersion.title: schemaVersion
schemaVersion.description: Contract version of this input. Must be hw-radar-input/v1.

fixtureCommit.title: fixtureCommit
fixtureCommit.description: 40-hex commit SHA of the public hw-radar repository whose fixture pages are fetched.

fixturePaths.title: fixturePaths
fixturePaths.description: Page paths relative to actors/hw-radar-synthetic-collector/fixtures/source/, fetched in order.

faultMode.title: faultMode
faultMode.description: Synthetic Actor only: forces one deterministic MS2-D-14 classification row.
